name: Professor Layton and the Turnabout of the Golden Witch
source: A crossover between the Umineko no Naku Koro ni/Professor Layton series, Professor Layton and the Turnabout of the Golden Witch is meant to serve as a hypothetical ninth entry in the Umineko series. You play as Professor Layton, who gets taken to the world of witches and fantasy to prove the events that took place on Rokkenjima in 1986 belonged to the world of mystery and reality.
translation: 《海猫的踪迹》/《雷顿教授》系列之间的联动作品《雷顿教授与黄金魔女的逆转》旨在作为《海猫》系列中假设的第九个作品。你扮演雷顿教授，他被带到女巫和奇幻的世界，以证明1986年六剑岛上发生的事件属于神秘和现实的世界。
